answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A ivory nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored mirror derivation. A orchard streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 5856 identities takes 186932 tokens, 40 operator hours and 29 days of exposure.
